title: Week 9 PM report
body: Saints cut Kendre Miller: add Alvin Kamara ($0 free agent), drop Josh Downs, start Kamara at FLEX over Keenan Allen before Sun 11 AM MT. Moore cleared and stays in; Tyson stays benched. Hold $100 FAAB.

title: Week 9 AM report
body: Kamara still a free agent: optional $0 add (drop Downs), start at FLEX over Allen before 11 AM MT. Low confidence now: Estime/White split carries. Skipping costs ~1 pt. No other changes; hold $100.

title: Game day: Sun 1 PM ET
body: No changes: Goff, Judkins, Cooper, Allen all active. Keep Allen at FLEX, skip Kamara (Estime lead role). Lock 11 AM MT. If Jacobs is out at ~12:55 PM MT, start Hampton by 2:05 PM MT.

title: Flash: Tyson cleared
body: Tyson's injury tag is gone (active vs CLE), but no changes: keep him on the bench (6.3 proj vs Allen 11.4). Lock 11 AM MT. If Jacobs is inactive, start Hampton by 2:05 PM MT.

title: Game day: Sun late afternoon
body: No changes. Jacobs, Kittle, Gay have no injury tags. GB inactives post any minute: if Jacobs is out, start Hampton (locks 2:05 PM MT). Kittle locks 2:25 PM MT. No pivot left for Moore Mon.

title: Flash: Jacobs hurt hand, questionable to return
body: Jacobs left GB @ NE with a hand injury (4 car, 5 yds), questionable to return. No move possible: Hampton already locked. Watch his Week 10 practice reports; Dowdle/Hampton are the backups.

title: Week 9 PM report
body: No lineup moves left (only Moore Mon). Claim Audric Estime (NO RB) $6–12, drop Josh Downs: covers Week 11 Jacobs/Judkins byes and Jacobs' hand. Jacobs no postgame update yet. Wk 10: Goff locks 7:30 AM MT (Munich).

title: Week 9 AM report
body: No moves left in Wk 9 (Moore plays tonight). Jacobs: fractured ring finger, expected to play Wk 10 (~75%). Claim Audric Estime $6–12, drop Downs. Optional: Corey Kiner $1–3, drop Hampton (Stevenson knee).

title: Flash: Jacobs needs finger surgery
body: Jacobs out 1-3 wks after finger surgery (likely back Wk 12). Raise Estime claim to $10-16, drop Downs. Wk 10 without Estime: start Judkins + Dowdle (SNF), Hampton as pivot. Keep Jacobs. No Wk 9 changes.

title: Game day: Mon night
body: No changes needed. DJ Moore is active for BUF @ MIN (6:15 PM MT); the ESPN report that he was out was a mix-up. Everyone else has played. Still place the Estime claim ($10–16, drop Downs).
